content:
Maria (AE): Hey team — need quick help approving a partner reseller margin for an upcoming commit. Channel partner NexusCloud is asking for an 18% customer discount and wants a 9% reseller margin. Deal is a 12-month committed plan, ARR ~$180k. We need special co-sell credit terms + a POC success clause. Can we get deal-desk + finance signoff ASAP? :pray:

Sanjay (Partner Lead): NexusCloud will drive onboarding and will only sign if margin >= 9%. They can commit to joint GTM if we hit that. They've already done a small POC with Product and it passed.

Lee (Deal Desk): Quick Qs: what's the requested discount off list, and are we giving any extra rebates? Also need a short justification for partner enablement.

Maria (AE): Asking for an 18% off list price, plus a one-time co-sell credit of $12k for joint demand gen, and a POC milestone that refunds first-month if SLA not met. Justification: partner brings 2 strategic logos + will close region expansion in APAC. Opportunity link: https://crm.redwood.ai/opps/RED-4521 :eyes:

Olivia (Sales Ops): FYI precedent: last quarter we approved a partner special for 15% discount + 8% margin on a $100k commit (see notes in /deals/precedents/2025-q3-partners). We escalated due to co-sell credit. Legal flagged the refund clause.

deal-desk-bot: Automated check — Special terms detected (co-sell credit, refund clause). Required approvals: Deal Desk, Finance, Legal. Routing to approvers...

Lee (Deal Desk): Proposed structure from Deal Desk POV:
```
- Customer discount: 18% off list
- Reseller margin to partner: 9% (one-off approval requested)
- Co-sell credit: $12,000 paid after 30-day milestone
- Commit: $180,000 ARR, 12 months
- Performance guardrail: POC milestone w/ refund cap = 1 month invoice
```
Need a short business case and finance to confirm impact on unit economics. If finance pushes back, fallback: 17% discount + 8% margin + tiered attainment rebate (5% on first-year attainment).

Sanjay (Partner Lead): NexusCloud pushes back below 9% margin — they'll walk. They asked specifically for a minimum 9% to staff their reseller enablement team.

Maria (AE): I'm requesting an exception approval for 9% margin. This unlocks $180k commit and an expected $450k expansion in Y2 from two logos. POC completion planned in 3 weeks. We need to finalize contract to hit fiscal quarter close. @Lee (Deal Desk) can you escalate to finance + legal? :clock1:

Lee (Deal Desk): Yep — escalating now. @Finance please review expected margin impact, here's a quick rate-card snippet for modeling:
```
list_price_per_token_unit = $0.0008
list_price_per_embedding = $0.02
expected_token_usage = 25M/year
expected_embedding_units = 200k/year
estimated_revenue = $180000
```
Attach the opp id and partner contract when you reply. I've marked this high priority.

Olivia (Sales Ops): Dropping the precedent doc excerpt to help finance modeling:
"2025-Q3 Partner Enablement — Partner X: 15% off list, 8% reseller margin, $8k co-sell credit, approved by CFO after legal edits. Outcome: closed $105k commit; +$220k expansion."

deal-desk-bot: Status update — Escalated to Finance and Legal. Timeline: estimated 24-36 hours for response.

Lee (Deal Desk): For clarity, if finance approves 9% margin we still require legal sign-off on refund clause language (cap & SLA). I've set the approval path to: Finance -> Legal -> CRO signature. I'll post the approved redlines in thread when received.

Sanjay (Partner Lead): Thanks — I'll hold partner conditional on our confirmation. They can move fast once we lock in margin.

Maria (AE): Thanks all. If anyone needs attachments I can paste the contract excerpt and POC success criteria here. Urgent for quarter close. :rocket:
